title: Harness log entry contract
description: One append-only log entry for one completed harness function invocation. The persisted log entry integrates the function report with its wall-clock write time; the report contains its session context and function-specific payload. The envelope (timestamp + report) is declared once; the report's oneOf selects exactly one concrete report contract — each output contract pins context.function to its own const, so the branches are mutually exclusive by discriminator.

timestamp.description: Wall-clock time the log entry was appended.

report.description: The function report persisted by this entry — exactly one of the twelve function output contracts, selected by its context.function discriminator.
